description: Manage node.js packages with Node Package Manager (npm).

parameters.name: ci
parameters.description: Install packages based on package-lock file, same as running npm ci. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: executable
parameters.description: The executable location for npm. This is useful if you are using a version manager, such as nvm.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Use the --force flag when installing. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: Install the node.js library globally. When global=true, then path is not used to install the packages. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: ignore_scripts
parameters.description: Use the --ignore-scripts flag when installing. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of a node.js library to install.

parameters.name: no_bin_links
parameters.description: Use the --no-bin-links flag when installing. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: no_optional
parameters.description: Use the --no-optional flag when installing. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The base path where to install the node.js libraries. When global=true, then path is not used to install the packages.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: Install dependencies in production mode, excluding devDependencies. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: registry
parameters.description: The registry to install modules from.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state of the node.js library. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "latest"

parameters.name: unsafe_perm
parameters.description: Use the --unsafe-perm flag when installing. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Install "coffee-script" node.js package.
  community.general.npm:
    name: coffee-script
    path: /app/location

- name: Install "coffee-script" node.js package on version 1.6.1.
  community.general.npm:
    name: coffee-script
    version: '1.6.1'
    path: /app/location

- name: Install "coffee-script" node.js package globally.
  community.general.npm:
    name: coffee-script
    global: true

- name: Force Install "coffee-script" node.js package.
  community.general.npm:
    name: coffee-script
    force: true

- name: Remove the globally package "coffee-script".
  community.general.npm:
    name: coffee-script
    global: true
    state: absent

- name: Install "coffee-script" node.js package from custom registry.
  community.general.npm:
    name: coffee-script
    registry: 'http://registry.mysite.com'

- name: Install packages based on package.json.
  community.general.npm:
    path: /app/location

- name: Update packages based on package.json to their latest version.
  community.general.npm:
    path: /app/location
    state: latest

- name: Install packages based on package.json using the npm installed with nvm v0.10.1.
  community.general.npm:
    path: /app/location
    executable: /opt/nvm/v0.10.1/bin/npm
    state: present
